title: Kahru Satellite Areas
description: Satellite chlorophyll areas 2-6 of Kahru et al. 2012 (Deep-Sea Research II): north of line 80 area 3 is coastal (0-100 km from shore) and area 2 the transition (100-300 km); south of it 6 coastal, 5 transition, 4 offshore (area 1, offshore north, holds too few stations). Each area is the union of the CalCOFI grid cells (calcofi4r cc_grid) of its listed stations, whole cells: a line-80 cell is in the one area Kahru listed it in, cells on the 100 km and 300 km borders are not halved, and the nine SCCOOS inshore station cells, not on the lists, are in no area
